title: Build project scaffold and config layer
description: Create directory structure, requirements.txt, .env.example, config/settings.py. All settings loaded from .env via python-dotenv. See spec.md for full env var list.

title: Build data models and database layer
description: Create data/models.py (Pydantic v2: Trader, Position, Market, Signal, PaperTrade, DailyStats) and data/db.py (aiosqlite SQLite interface with all tables: traders, signals, paper_trades, market_cache, daily_stats). Full CRUD and query helpers for dashboard.

title: Build core fetcher and filter modules
description: Create core/fetcher.py (async httpx: get_top_traders, get_active_positions, get_market_metadata with retry/backoff/cache) and core/filter.py (filter_traders with all 7 filters, score_trader composite scoring). See spec.md section 1 and 2.

title: Build consensus engine and trader execution
description: Create core/consensus.py (detect_consensus groups positions by market+outcome, emits Signal with thresholds STRONG>=70%/MODERATE 50-69%/WEAK 35-49%, time-window guard 2min-24h) and core/trader.py (open_trade, close_trade, get_open_trades, check_and_close_expired_trades with PaperTrade model). See spec.md sections 3 and 4.
closeReason: consensus.py + trader.py implemented directly in master

title: Build scheduler, Discord notifier, and Streamlit dashboard
description: Create core/scheduler.py (APScheduler pipeline loop: fetch->filter->consensus->trade->notify), notifications/discord_webhook.py (send_trade_opened, send_trade_closed, send_bot_status, send_daily_summary with Discord embeds), and dashboard/app.py (Streamlit with 6 pages: Overview, Live Signals, Open Trades, Trade History, Trader Leaderboard, Settings). See spec.md sections 5-8.
closeReason: scheduler.py + discord_webhook.py + dashboard/app.py implemented directly in master

title: Build test suite
description: Create tests/ with pytest+pytest-asyncio unit tests for filter.py (all 7 filters), consensus.py (threshold detection, time guards), trader.py (open/close/dedup), and fetcher.py (retry logic). See spec.md testing section.
closeReason: 100 tests written and passing: filter (33), consensus (28), fetcher (20), trader (15), settings (2), db (2)

title: Create and maintain status.md development tracker
description: Create status.md at the repo root that tracks the exact current state of development. Include: overall progress, which modules are built/pending/in-progress, current git branches and their status, which seeds issues are open/closed, any blockers. Must be accurate enough that a new session can pick up exactly where we left off.

title: Refactor API layer to verified Polymarket endpoints (v2 spec)
description: Update fetcher.py, filter.py, settings.py, models.py to match spec v2.0 API architecture. Three API backends: Data API (leaderboard+positions+activity), Gamma API (market metadata), CLOB API (fill+current price). Remove win_rate filter. Add min_pnl/min_vol/min_trades/min_open_positions filters. Add get_trader_activity(), get_fill_price(), get_current_price() to fetcher. Fix /positions endpoint to /v1/positions. Add vol+num_open_positions fields to Trader model. Update scheduler pipeline to fetch activity before filtering.
closeReason: Refactored API layer to v2 spec: three backend architecture (Data/Gamma/CLOB), fixed /positions to /v1/positions, added get_trader_activity/get_fill_price/get_current_price, added vol+num_open_positions to Trader model, removed win_rate filter, added min_pnl/vol/open_positions filters, updated scheduler to enrich with activity before filtering. 110 tests passing.
